title: Hotels with a Pantheon view: which room to book
metaDescription: Three Rome hotels around Piazza della Rotonda with a Pantheon view, the exact room category to book at each, and the annex and plain rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with a Pantheon view, and which room to book
dek: Three hotels around Piazza della Rotonda, the square in front of the Pantheon in Rome. For each one we list the room category sold with the view, and the annex and plain rooms that look elsewhere.
teaser: Six categories at one hotel name the Pantheon. At another, a travel guide, not the hotel, says its suite faces the temple.

decoder.text: Both are sold at Hotel Abruzzi. The annex room's name has no view in it, so only the one with Pantheon View in its name is for this view.
At Albergo del Senato the Standard Double is sold with no view named. Book the Superior Room with Pantheon View to get the view.
At The Pantheon Iconic Rome Hotel the Santa Chiara Suite is sold without the Pantheon in its name. Only the Pantheon Suite is named for the view, and a travel guide says it overlooks the temple.

faq.q: Which Rome hotels sell rooms with a Pantheon view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026, Hotel Abruzzi and Albergo del Senato sell room categories with Pantheon View in the name. The Pantheon Iconic Rome Hotel names no view in its room names, but a travel guide says its Pantheon Suite overlooks the temple.

faq.q: Which room should I book at Hotel Abruzzi?
faq.a: Any category with Pantheon View in its name, such as the Double or Twin Room with Pantheon View. The annex and De Luxe categories on its page name no view, so skip them.

faq.q: Is the Pantheon Suite guaranteed to have the view?
faq.a: No. Only a travel guide says it overlooks the Pantheon. The hotel's own page does not say so, so ask the hotel to confirm the room before you book.

faq.q: Is a Santa Chiara Suite the same as a Pantheon view?
faq.a: No. The Santa Chiara Suite is sold without the Pantheon in its name. Book the category that has the Pantheon in its name instead.
